theme.rationale: The user explicitly requested a premium dark futuristic AI/ML developer portfolio with neon blue/purple/cyan highlights. We are applying the 'Electric & Neon' archetype heavily leaning into a 'Terminal/Cyberpunk' micro-theme. It utilizes deep void black backgrounds to let the glowing cyan and purple neon colors pop, creating an immersive, high-end technical feel.
theme.mood: Futuristic, Highly Technical, Premium, Immersive, Cyberspace

gradients.text_highlight: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 via-blue-500 to-purple-600

typography.strategy: The 'Editorial Future' pairing: A wide, high-impact sans-serif for headings (Outfit) paired with a sterile, technical monospace (JetBrains Mono) for accents and data, rounded out with a highly legible geometric sans (Inter) for body copy.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy combined with strict Grids.

grids.projects: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 (Mode A: The Tetris Grid). Mix span logic to create asymmetry.
grids.skills_stats: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 (Mode B: The Control Room Grid). Dense, functional, packed with data.

navbar.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5
navbar.notes: Must hide/show on scroll or shrink. Smooth transitions.

cards.classes: bg-[#0A0A0F] border border-white/5 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:border-cyan-500/50 hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,240,255,0.1)] transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: relative overflow-hidden bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/50 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-mono text-sm tracking-wide hover:bg-cyan-500 hover:text-black hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: px-6 py-3 rounded-lg text-gray-300 border border-white/10 hover:border-white/30 hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300

motion_and_effects.global: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered staggered reveals. Enter from y=20, opacity=0.
motion_and_effects.hero_typing: Use 'react-type-animation' for cycling roles: 'AI/ML Engineer', 'Python Developer', 'Full Stack Developer'.
motion_and_effects.background_particles: Implement 'tsparticles' with a custom neon network config (cyan/purple links) running in the background at low opacity (z-0).
motion_and_effects.cursor: Custom glowing dot cursor following the mouse (framer-motion).
motion_and_effects.hover_effects: Lift items slightly (-translate-y-1) and introduce neon drop-shadows on hover.

image_urls.description: Abstract blue grid pattern with glowing lines, ideal for hero background overlay (at 10-20% opacity)
Silhouette of a programmer coding in a dark room. Good for 'About Me' or generic project card.
Abstract streaks of purple and pink neon lights. Good for AI/ML visualization project.
Abstract neon lines on a dark background. Good for backend/architecture project.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over neon elements maintains WCAG AA contrast. Use text-shadow on hero text if placed over particles.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-resume-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Next.js 15 (App Router if applicable, or adapt to the stack provided). Use standard Tailwind for all layouts.
For the hero section, implement a dynamic, floating layout. Use Framer Motion for the typing text and floating tech icons (React, Node, Python, TensorFlow icons from lucide-react or react-icons).
For the background, use `react-tsparticles` configured to look like a neural network (points connected by lines) in cyan and purple.
Build the 'Featured Projects' section using the 'Tetris' grid layout (some items span 2 columns, some 1) to create an organic, artistic feel rather than a boring uniform grid.

For 'Skills' and 'GitHub Stats', use dense, dashboard-like cards (Control Room grid). Consider using Recharts for AI/ML workflow visualizations if needed, or simple custom HTML/CSS progress/stat bars.
Ensure the Navbar is sticky with a glassmorphism blur and subtle bottom border.
Do NOT use generic card shadows; use crisp borders (border-white/5) that glow (border-cyan-500/50) on hover.
Do NOT use Shadcn Card component if it restricts layout freedom. Build custom HTML/Tailwind divs for project cards to achieve the exact retro-futuristic look.
Use `lucide-react` or `@phosphor-icons/react` for UI icons. Use `react-icons` for tech stack logos (e.g., SiPython, SiReact).
